summary: Kilo's AI Gateway allows unauthenticated access to models tagged :free, with anonymous requests limited to 200 requests per hour per IP.
claim_steps: Choose a Kilo Gateway model tagged :free.
Call the gateway without an Authorization header, or use a Kilo API key if preferred.
Stay within the 200 requests per hour per IP anonymous limit.

social_proof.title: Authentication | Kilo Code Docs
social_proof.text: The gateway allows unauthenticated access for free models only. Anonymous requests are identified by IP address and are subject to rate limiting (200 requests per hour per IP).
